chapter.title: OF CONTEMPTS OF THE LAWFUL AUTHORITY OF PUBLIC SERVANTS

heading: Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions.
text: Whoever voluntarily obstructs any public servant in the discharge of his public functions, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees, or with both.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
